overview.text: The Lined Snake is a small, harmless snake of the central United States. It is the only species in its genus.

identification.text: Olive-green to brown with a tan or yellow stripe down the back and one along each side; the belly has two rows of neat black half-moon spots.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: The central United States from Illinois to Colorado and Texas.

habitat.text: Savanna, shrubland and grassland with soft, moist soil - also backyards, vacant lots and dumps.

behaviour.text: Spends most of its time hidden under rocks, leaves and logs or in the soil.

reproduction.text: Gives birth to about seven or eight live young in August, each 10 to 12 cm long.

recognise.text: Two rows of black half-moons down the belly.
Light stripe down the middle of the back.
